$comment: Ping's spoken lines for the episode (author's prompt #22), text exactly as in the script (CodeMask repo, episodes/03-ping-vtuber/script.en.md, sha256 8aca74c7e89668ef...). The tag is not sent to ElevenLabs: lib/script-tags.mjs parseTags removes it and turns it into an emotion mark. Rendering settings below are chosen values, labelled so.

hook.text: Not long ago, I was just a picture.

alive.text: [happy] I just blinked. Did you see it?

fix.text: [happy] Sixteen out of sixteen. Write that down.

outro.text: [sleepy] And I am going to sleep.
outro.tailWhy: the author's prompt #22: in the outro the eyes stay shut after the line and the cursor keeps blinking for 3 s

livenessSeedWhy: Chosen: the same seed as every other clip of this project, so liveness is the one already shown and measured.
emotionMark: a tag before the line puts its mark transitionFrames before the first letter's frame in the clip (lib/line.mjs lineMarks), so the emotion is complete on that letter

leadTailRule.rule: every line clip starts 0.5 s before the sound and ends 0.5 s after it (the outro keeps its 3 s); the line's emotion eases in during the lead so that it is fully there on the first letter; during the lead and the tail the mouth is the emotion's mouth and liveness runs
leadTailRule.changedAfterSeeing: the contact sheet of prompt #22's footage (each line started neutral and reached its emotion only during the first words)
leadTailRule.before: no lead; 15 rest frames after the audio; the tag's emotion started at the first letter and eased in over 8 frames

noBlinkAtTheEnd: Decided by Claude for prompt #23 (no clip may end on a blink): if the last tail frame falls in a liveness blink, the tail grows frame by frame until the eyes are open again; the outro is exempt (sleepy shuts the eyes on purpose).
